generation_policy.upper_annotation_requirement: All upper annotations are intentionally represented by two large formal boxes: MISSED_APPROACH_TEXT and PLAN_VIEW.
generation_policy.coarse_box_requirement: two upper formal annotation boxes: MISSED_APPROACH_TEXT and PLAN_VIEW
generation_policy.lower_detail_requirement: use one user red-box ROI as the lower/profile missed-approach detail area, then generate only fine-grained symbol boxes inside that ROI; no visible per-leg blue step boxes are generated
generation_policy.lower_detail_box_source: curated lower/profile grid completion for the 10 pilot charts, then automatic second-pass supplement from uncovered detected candidates inside the user ROI
generation_policy.auto_detected_grid_gap_supplement_mode: available but disabled by default for curated pilot charts to preserve the reviewed grid effect; set FAA_ENABLE_GRID_GAP_SUPPLEMENT=1 for supplement experiments
generation_policy.duplicate_policy: overlapping fine-grained boxes for the same leg are merged into one visible box with combined candidate mappings
